title: ROI / Cashflow Product Calculation - Excel Google Sheets
description:
Hey!

We are a small E-Commerce company that primarly sells on Amazon and we manufacture products with third party factories.

We already have a detailed Product ROI Calculator in Google Sheets and we like to add a modified annualized ROI formula where the ROI is connected to the timing AND the percentage of a payment.

Example:

Normal ROI is calculated based on the net profit / total investment.

But in reality Product A may have only 10% margin but can be paid 60 days after arrival while Product B has 30% margin but needs 30% balance upfront and the remaining 70% 60 days into the production we wait 30 more days until the product arrives.

In that case Product A maybe much more beneficial for the company because of its much better cashflow aspect even if it has only 1/3 of Product B's margin.

The goal is to integrate the cashflow aspect into the Product Calculator to make better decisions on which product should be developed next.

Following data points should be included:

PAYMENT DATA POINTS
1. Upfront balance (in % and no of days)
2. Production finish payment  (in % and no of days)

title: Public Survey to assess perceptions of Longevity / Healthspan Science and Research
description:
VitaDAO is a global community of longevity enthusiasts, researchers, and contributors working to identify, fund, and incubate research in longevity science. In the past year we have funded more than 15 ageing research projects and initiatives, sponsored multiple longevity conferences, and provided travel grants to early-stage researchers.  We invite you to explore our website at https://www.vitadao.com/.

As part of of 2023 strategic plan we are endeavoring to tackle a messaging problem - legitimate longevity science driven by highly accomplished Ph.D. researchers is being intermixed with social media and fad "experts" and non-verifiable science. This, we believe is making it difficult for the general public to appreciate the work being done in the longevity science space.

Additionally the marketing of supplements, cremes, and a number of cosmetic "therapies" many of which are of questionable effect,  are diluting and in some cases outright discrediting the field. We seek to regain control of the narrative and give the general public an honest view of the science that is happening right now in the space focused on improved healthspan and ultimately lifespan.

As part of this process, and recognizing that those within our eco-system are already sold on the benefits of longevity science we need to establish how best to communicate outward to the general public about the field of longevity research.

This first survey is to be designed (and will be implemented in SurveyMonkey) with the goal of identifying the concerns/blockers of the general public towards extending lifespan through science.

Examples of some of the arguments against this kind of research that we often get are:

•Overpopulation / Resource Scarcity, 
•The notion that aging must lead to poor health and frailty, 
•Preventing death isn't moral or "natural". 

We need to establish both the policy concerns, but also looking for insight on how to make the topic personally relevant.

This job is to design the survey which will then be implemented using the SurveyMonkey service by our team. . We are looking for expertise in question development/answer format to help us formulate our strategy.

title: Cards game for App Store and play store
description:
‏Dealing
‏The cards are dealt counter-clockwise starting from the player on the right side of the Dealer to the player on his Left. Each player receives a pack of three cards, then two cards. After the four players receive the first five cards, the remaining cards are left face down except for the card on the top, which is turned face up, and it’s called the bidding card.
‏As soon as a player takes the bidding card the rest of the cards are dealt:
‏2 cards for the player who took the bidding cards
‏3 cards for the remaining players
‏Bidding
‏You get the chance to choose between Sunn and Hokom, depending on which one supports your cards, which one supports your card. You decide your bidding on the public card that is shown to the players. The bidding is made in two rounds. If everybody passed on the first round and the second round starts.
‏The player can propose Sunn or Hokom whether on the first or second round. If none of the players took the bidding cards in both rounds, the cards are reshuffled and a new round begins. The player on the right of the dealer becomes the dealer.
‏Scoring
‏To score points for the game, the team of the player who accepted the bidding card must score more than the other team. In Sunn they should score more than 65 points or more, otherwise, the other team gets 26 points in the score. In case of Hokom the team who called the bidding card should score more than 81 points or more, otherwise the other team will get 16 points in the score.
‏* In Hokom the player who holds the trump Queen and King can call Belot, as the first of these cards is laid, the player calls “Belot”

‏Note: Seven and Eights always give 0 points, no matter the suit
‏The points from the tricks are totalled up for both teams. An additional 10 points are awarded for the last trick, if all of the tricks are won by the same team (Capot), they get the full score If the other team wins, the team receives all of the trick points.
‏If this is the case, the losing team no points In order, the bid to be successful the team must win more points than the opponent.
‏The team who reaches 152 points wins.
‏Actions
‏Projects or declarations are free extra points one of the two teams can earn during a Round. Projects (except for Baloot) are always declared in the first turn and shown in the second turn There are several types of bonuses in Baloot.
‏The card order for sequence is: 7,8,9,10,J,Q,K,A
‏If the same card is part of a square and a sequence (tierce, quarte, quint) the player chooses which to announce.
‏If both teams announce sequences, premiums are given only to the team that announced the higher sequence. If both sequences are of equal length, higher is considered the one that contains higher ranked cards.

‏If you try to cheat during a game (such as the deliberate loss of a match or using multiple false accounts in order to increase your chances of winning), you will be facing consequences because you’re ruining the game for others. The penalties are as follows:

title: Compilers Project: Local Register Allocation
description:
Project Description
In this project, your task is to implement an algorithm for local register allocation. You may use any
of the following programming language to implement your allocator: C, C++, Java, and Python. Your
program has to work correctly on the ilab cluster. Make sure your allocator compiles and runs on ilab.
You will build a program that takes as input a file containing a sequence of ILOC operations, and produces
a sequence of ILOC operations that are functionally equivalent. The desired difference between the files is
that the output file should use no more than k registers, where k is an input parameter that your program
reads from the command line.
Your program should take three command line arguments. They are, in order:
• The number, k, of registers that the allocator will assume for the target machine.
• The name of the input file.
• The name of the output file.
The output should be written to a file, the name of which is specified by the third argument to the
command line. The output should not be written to stdout. The executable should be named alloc (for
C/C++ version), alloc.py (for Python version), or alloc.java (for Java version).

Specific Details
Implement a bottom-up local register allocator. Test your
allocator thoroughly. Test basic blocks are available to help in this process. You should invent some of your
own test blocks as well to handle edge cases. 

Use the simulator sim to ensure that your allocated code is correct, and to determine its execution time
(#cycles, #operations executed as reported by the simulator). Run your allocator on each of the test blocks.

I need the project code, a ReadMe file containing a brief description of each source code file
for instance, how the allocator can be invoked, and/or how an executable can be generated. For C/C++
implementation, please provide a Makefile that yields the executable alloc when typing Make. For Python
implementation, please make sure the main file is alloc.py. Please use “python3” command on ilab, instead
of “python”. For Java implementation, please ensure the main file is alloc.java.

You can assume the input ILOC programs are correct, i.e., will run through the simulator. Your allocator
may assume that there are no more than 256 virtual registers in the program. We already have a limit of
256 virtual register values that we can spill (byte addresses 0 through 1023). Your register allocator has to
handle ILOC instructions as they occur in the provided ILOC test blocks. In particular, instructions do not
have labels, and there are no branch instructions. Memory operations are limited to load, loadI, and store.
Do not perform any code optimizations. Do not perform optimizations!
Memory instructions allowed for spilling code are the following: load/store. You are allowed to use loadI
to initialize a register with an immediate number.

It is my understanding many bitcoin miners have CGMiner on them even today in 2023.

My algo is very similar to btc mining with slight variations. 

A lot of random values are generated. Each random value is hashed several times. 

Then the integer of the hash is 
1)checked to see if it is in-range of value1 and value2 if it is in range, the hash is hashed 3 million more times.
2) If any of the 3million hashes are equal to value 3, a block has been mined. 

This will make more sense when you see my code. 


Once I hire you, I'd like you to answer these 5 questions

1. Do most btc miners still have cgminer on them?

3. Can I modify cgminer version of btc algorithm to remove pool features and other unnecessary code to just let me test my algorithm in solo mining locally on the ASIC?
4. Can I run tests of my mining algorithm on a ASIC miner by myself (just printing valid block to screen) just to see how long it takes to find valid blocks?
5. If it can't be done with cgminer, is there another common  open source mining software that could be edited and deployed successfully with a custom mining algorithm using SHA-256?

description:
Hey!

We are a small E-Commerce company that primarly sells on Amazon and we manufacture products with third party factories.

We already have a detailed Product ROI Calculator in Google Sheets and we like to add a modified annualized ROI formula where the ROI is connected to the timing AND the percentage of a payment.

Example:

Normal ROI is calculated based on the net profit / total investment.

But in reality Product A may have only 10% margin but can be paid 60 days after arrival while Product B has 30% margin but needs 30% balance upfront and the remaining 70% 60 days into the production we wait 30 more days until the product arrives.

In that case Product A maybe much more beneficial for the company because of its much better cashflow aspect even if it has only 1/3 of Product B's margin.

The goal is to integrate the cashflow aspect into the Product Calculator to make better decisions on which product should be developed next.

Following data points should be included:

PAYMENT DATA POINTS
1. Upfront balance (in % and no of days)
2. Production finish payment  (in % and no of days)
3. Payment on terms e.g. net 60 days  (in % and no of days)
4. Total Investment amount

GENERAL DATA POINTS
4. Production lead time 
5. Shipping time 
6. Contribution Margin 
7. Number of sales per month 


Note: 
Annualized ROI assumes unlimited continious demand, perfect production circumstances and ideal reordering and as a result will never fully transpire.

title: Access database - easy SQL querry
description:
I would like someone to do the following work to the data in an acess table as soon as possible (I know as always!!). Please use SQL querries so that I can see the actual queeries used when the database come back to me. Thank you.

The first SQL querry is as follows:

In the column Q there is a 'x' to indicate it is a row that needs to be divided into 3 ie:

1. from the left hand side to the first coma (,) goes into the surname column;
2. working backwards from the extreme right hand side to the opening bracket (ie ( ) goes into the allelse column;
3. everything from the coma (the coma after the surname) to the opening bracket goes into the initials column.

The second SQL querry is to do the following. There will be some rows with names that have 'x' in the Q column that were not processed. This is because they do not contain an opening bracket. Most of these rows are simply like 'WOOD, C L The 1914-8 War.' For these:

1. from the left hand side to the first coma (,) goes into the surname column;
2. working backwards from the extreme right hand side extract ' The 1914-8 War.' to go into the allelse column;
3. everything from the coma (the coma after the surname) to ' The 1914-8 War.' goes into the initials column.

That is it - if there is anything left over I hope I can deal with it manually.

I have no idea what this is worth in terms of a fee but I did one of these with a techie the other day and it took about 30 minutes. So please sharpen you pencils and bid what it is worth to you.

The full database will be sent to the winning freelancer via dropbox.

Many thanks

Appreciation for building applications that show empathy for the customers using them, and the other developers who work with it.

Desire and ability to stretch beyond the environments, frameworks, and stacks that you’re already most comfortable with.

Proactive and clear communication abilities.

title: URGENT: Access database - easy SQL querry
description:
I would like someone to do the following work to the data in an acess table as soon as possible (I know as always!!). Please use SQL querries so that I can see the actual queeries used when the database come back to me. Thank you.

The first SQL querry is as follows:

In the column Q there is a 'x' to indicate it is a row that needs to be divided into 3 ie:

1. from the left hand side to the first coma (,) goes into the surname column;
2. working backwards from the extreme right hand side to the opening bracket (ie ( ) goes into the allelse column;
3. everything from the coma (the coma after the surname) to the opening bracket goes into the initials column.

The second SQL querry is to do the following. There will be some rows with names that have 'x' in the Q column that were not processed. This is because they do not contain an opening bracket. Most of these rows are simply like 'WOOD, C L The 1914-8 War.' For these:

1. from the left hand side to the first coma (,) goes into the surname column;
2. working backwards from the extreme right hand side extract ' The 1914-8 War.' to go into the allelse column;
3. everything from the coma (the coma after the surname) to ' The 1914-8 War.' goes into the initials column.

That is it - if there is anything left over I hope I can deal with it manually.

I have no idea what this is worth in terms of a fee but I did one of these with a techie the other day and it took about 30 minutes. So please sharpen you pencils and bid what it is worth to you.

The full database will be sent to the winning freelancer via dropbox.

Many thanks

Position Details

Who We Are

The Otaku Box is one of the largest anime subscription boxes, sending customers all over the world a box of exclusive anime loot they can’t get anywhere else. Even better, customers get to vote on the loot they receive, directly influencing what goes in the box each month. 

IMPORTANT: everyone at The Otaku Box is a Manager of (at least) One!

PLEASE SEND AN EXAMPLE OF THE AUTOMATION FLOW YOU HAVE CREATED.

So, what’s a manager of one?

A manager of one is someone who ideates and/or identifies new work, implements that work, measures that work, reports on that work, then optimizes that work - without being told, and without excuse

Note that ‘work’ can be a specific task or a system, process, collaboration, idea, project, and more!

Managers of one do not think or say things like:

“No one told me to do that”
“I wasn’t tasked with that”
“That’s not my job”
“Someone else was supposed to do that”
“Someone else didn’t do something so I couldn’t do this”

Managers of one do not do things like:

Allow tasks to run overdue
Fail to respond to comments, updates, and similar
Fail at any of 5 key precepts of being a Manager of One
Make excuses of any kind, ever

Managers of one do things like:

- Task themselves with work, both identified and ideated
- Optimize their workflow and processes
- Identify and then solve their own bottlenecks and those of the larger team
- Implement new workflow and processes that not only assist their work but the work of the entire team
- Take responsibility for the growth, improvement, and/or forward direction of work, processes, and, ultimately, the foundation
- Have incredible attention to detail
- Own their work, responsibility, and role
- Continually learn new skills, software, systems, and thought processes

When managers of one have a question, they:

- Exhaustively research the problem, learning from a variety of resources, including everyone/anyone involved
- Attempt to solve the problem themselves
- Failing that, they propose two or more potential solutions for consideration when presenting the problem

Why do we hire managers of one

We live in a ‘gig’ economy that pushes wages as low as the lowest person on the planet is willing to accept for a given gig. Are all full of people looking to do told what to do and complete specific jobs for a very low rate. If you’re the kind of person that needs to have work dictated to them, you’re competing against many millions of others in the global gig economy, and that’s not what we’re looking for, which is why this position pays better than ‘gig’ work.
So, you will need to be a manager of one and ideate and/or identify work, implement that work, measure that work, report that work, and optimize that work!

The program is your choice (residence, office, cafe, restaurant etc...), however, the initial form of the building should be based on a rock that you have found. We will start this project by modeling a simplified faceted version of your found rock which will act as the building form for your design; it is a requirement for this assignment that you start the project in this manner and follow the steps in the Project 4 Intro lecture to model your rock in Revit using the In-Place massing tools. Once the building form has been modeled, you will design the interiors by adding the interior walls, bathroom(s), and kitchen with appliances (cabinets, countertops, plumbing fixtures etc...). Additionally, you will have to design/create your own custom staircase (not use the generic staircase in Revit) which I will cover the steps in a future lecture; the staircase design should be entirely your own (you should not copy the one provided in the future stair lecture).

The general form of your model should be derived from a rock formation and modeled using an In-Place Mass. It can be an abstraction of the rock formation, it does not have to be exact.
